sqlxml-engine live wire: real git dep (re-pinned to sqlxml main post-merge of PR #15), src-tauri/src/lib.rs split so the declared [lib] target exists, sqlxml_bridge::put() calls SqlxmlEngine::put() for real; get/query stay stubbed -- sqlxml-agent doesn't implement those actions yet
TypeScript design token inspector UI -- mountInspector() + src/index.html

MacroHarder identity swap -- tauri.conf.json product name + org.albertlane.macroharder-studio bundle id, package.json, doc headers, Rust crate rename (macrohard-studio -> macroharder-studio, macrohard_lib -> macroharder_lib)

Workbook core -- src-tauri/src/workbook.rs: CellAddress(col,row,layer) + CellValue + Volume (sparse grid) + Workbook (named volumes), 9 unit tests passing; 7 Tauri commands (workbook_create_volume/list_volumes/set_cell/get_cell/clear_cell/volume_bounds/non_empty_cells). SQLXML persistence is write-only via sqlxml_bridge::put() (Phase 7) -- no read-back until sqlxml adds a GET action server-side

Wire procurement MCP module as dashboard data source #1 -- src-tauri/src/mcp_client.rs (generic MCP JSON-RPC HTTP client) + config/modules.json registry + module_list/module_call_tool Tauri commands done. procurement-db D1 + document-archive R2 provisioned and migrated 2026-07-09 (PRO-P7-01 unblocked); code path is complete and will return live data once procurement's own wrangler deploy runs

Wire maps MCP module as dashboard data source #2 (3D terrain showcase) -- same mcp_client.rs + modules.json path as MH-P8-02. maps-cache D1 + map-tiles R2 provisioned and migrated 2026-07-09 (MAP-P7-01 unblocked); code path is complete and will return live data once maps' own wrangler deploy runs

src-tauri/src/layout.rs -- DashboardLayout/PanelPlacement grid schema: add/remove/move/resize/visibility/z-order, JSON persistence (load_or_default/save_to_path), 14 unit tests passing in isolation (GTK/WebKit unavailable in this sandbox so the full Tauri crate can't link, but the layout logic has zero Tauri dependencies and was verified standalone)

src/chrome.ts -- applies design-tokens.json onto chrome CSS custom properties (--bg/--surface/--accent/etc. + spacing + font-size scales) at runtime instead of the values being hardcoded literals in index.html's :root block (which now serves only as pre-token-load fallback)

src/dashboard-composer.ts -- renders DashboardLayout as a CSS grid of module panels; add-panel control (module + panel-type pickers from the registry), pointer-event drag-to-move, resize/hide/remove/bring-to-front controls, all wired to the 7 layout_* Tauri commands. New tsconfig.frontend.json (DOM lib) split from the Worker-side tsconfig.json so this actually typechecks in CI. Not runtime-tested -- no GTK/WebKit in this sandbox to launch the Tauri WebView

MCP module host -- src-tauri/src/registry.rs: ModuleRegistry (install/uninstall + validation), authorize_tool_call() capability gate (rejects undeclared tools; rejects write-shaped tool names on read_only modules), 12 unit tests passing. module_list/module_call_tool rewritten on top of it (was ad-hoc file reads with zero tool-name validation before). module_install/module_uninstall Tauri commands + composer 'Install module...' UX. config/modules.json gained capability/source fields on both built-in modules

AER integration -- src-tauri/src/aer.rs: AerWriteResponse + AerReadResponse typed structs, aer_write/aer_read async Tauri commands calling lane_aer_write/lane_aer_read on lane-mcp gateway via McpClient. mcp_client.rs gained with_api_key() builder (x-lane-api-key header for lane-mcp auth). Endpoint from LANE_MCP_ENDPOINT env var (default: https://mcp.albertlane.org/rpc); key from LANE_MCP_API_KEY. Graceful not_deployed degradation (non-fatal). 6/6 unit tests passing 2026-07-11

Filesystem integrity -- src-tauri/src/integrity.rs: BLAKE3 content-hash manifest (generate/load/verify), tracks design-tokens.json + config/modules.json + tauri.conf.json, non-fatal boot check in run() (eprintln! on mismatch, app continues), verify_integrity + generate_integrity_manifest Tauri commands. blake3 crate added to Cargo.toml. 6/6 unit tests passing 2026-07-11

Windows NSIS build -- tauri.conf.json updated with NSIS bundle config (installMode=currentUser, compression=lzma, copyright + homepage + shortDescription). .github/workflows/windows-build.yml: build-check on windows-latest (cargo build + test on every push/PR); package job on workflow_dispatch or semver tags producing NSIS .exe artifact uploaded to Actions. Not runtime-tested (Windows runner + display required)
Module install UX: signature/provenance verification for user-installed manifests, sandboxed capability review before first tool call, module marketplace/discovery surface
cc = '1' added to [build-dependencies] in Cargo.toml
kernels/matrix3d.c: matrix3d_multiply (4x4 column-major), vector3d_transform, matrix3d_identity, vector3d_dot, vector3d_cross
kernels/kriging.c: ordinary kriging with spherical semivariogram, partial-pivot Gaussian elimination, heap-allocated kriging system
build.rs: cc::Build compiles kernels/matrix3d.c + kernels/kriging.c into macroharder_kernels static lib with -O2; rerun-if-changed directives

src/compute.rs: safe Rust FFI wrappers (mat4_multiply, mat4_transform_vec4, mat4_identity, vec3_dot, vec3_cross, kriging_interp) + 10 unit tests covering identity, multiply, transform, dot/cross, kriging; 58/58 total tests passing 2026-07-12
